sectionHeadings: 230: Tenant self-hosted cron via in-app scheduler
§4 The lock and the scale tiers (decided)
record.summary: Tenant apps deploy self-hosted via OAP deployd, where Encore's `CronJob` primitive is a no-op (there is no Encore Cloud scheduler). This spec gives each tenant app working self-hosted cron via an in-app scheduler baked into the generated Encore app, with no per-tenant Kubernetes CronJob. The scheduler stores schedules in Postgres and fires due jobs against the app's own endpoints. The distributed lock is tiered by the tenant's scale choice in create-project: small scale uses a Postgres atomic claim (postgres-only); large scale uses Redis (postgres + redis), production-grade for multi-replica deployments. Cron therefore always requires data-postgres and optionally peers with data-redis. Implemented as a new factory-encore adapter `cron` module and surfaced as the create-project Infra-axis cron option. This is distinct from spec 224 (statecraft's OWN control-plane sweepers, which stay on per-sweeper K8s CronJobs).
record.title: Tenant self-hosted cron: in-app scheduler module (postgres small-scale / +redis large-scale), the create-project Infra axis
